text:
The largest planet in our solar system is **Jupiter**.

Some quick facts about Jupiter:

- **Mass:** About 318 times that of Earth (2.7 quadrillion US tons — 2.4 × 10²⁷ lb; 1.9 × 10²⁴ kg)
- **Volume:** About 1,321 times that of Earth (1.3 × 10¹⁵ km³; 3.4 × 10¹⁴ cu mi)
- **Equatorial radius:** About 71,000 km (44,000 mi) — roughly 11 times Earth
